verdict: The bonded GYROID is strain-controlled, so its figure of merit is σ_e/E_s, not σ_e (relative to Ti-6Al-4V: Ti-6Al-4V 1.00, Ti-6Al-7Nb 1.03, CP-Ti-Gr4 0.58, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 1.41, Ta 0.23, Ti-15Zr 1.19). An energy LOWER bound — it can show a ligament binding, never safe — puts the ligaments' RMS stress at ≥ 0.50–0.51 E_s·ε on the two FE readings, neither of which is the in-plane traction modulus the bound needs. On the lower reading (the radial one), at t_L = k_p = 1 with near-uniaxial ligaments, the bound alone reaches SF 2 above a stem surface strain of Ti-6Al-4V 1580, Ti-6Al-7Nb 1630, CP-Ti-Gr4 912, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 2222, Ta 367, Ti-15Zr 1876 µε on a large stem; k_p > 1 lowers these, t_L < 1 (not excluded) raises them. The source tree's upper surface strain (1837 µε, one tree, one gust), placed on a large stem, exceeds them for CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta, Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-6Al-7Nb on the lower reading (CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta, Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-6Al-7Nb on the higher; any stress state: CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta); its median for CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta. The bound stands on the part's in-plane modulus under traction being at least its FE reading (radial 0.0910 of E_s): the named static estimate (01_01 §5.2 — a reading that can sit on either side of the true static modulus, never a proof) lies above both FE readings at 45°, below both at θ = 0 and between them at 22.5° on every measured step — where it is not above both, this bound's «binds above» is not established. The periodic voxel case's ligament field — the INFINITE lattice under a uniaxial macro stress across the anchor's axis, a READING, neither this bound times a peak factor nor the inclusion's multiaxial state — puts the peak at p99 (the highest quantile that holds a band over the rungs; whether a smooth ligament's fatigue peak sits above or below it is not established) at 1.45–1.58 E_s·ε along the cube axis and 1.09–1.27 at 45°, over the rungs of the part's density and two measures (max|σ_i| ⊥ von Mises). At its lowest — von Mises at every sampled angle — and t_L = 1 the ligaments reach SF 2 on a large stem above Ti-6Al-4V 731, Ti-6Al-7Nb 754, CP-Ti-Gr4 422, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 1028, Ta 170, Ti-15Zr 868 µε at every sampled mount angle (Ti-6Al-4V 551, Ti-6Al-7Nb 568, CP-Ti-Gr4 318, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 774, Ta 128, Ti-15Zr 654 at θ = 0; on max|σ_i| alone, at every sampled angle: Ti-6Al-4V 654, Ti-6Al-7Nb 674, CP-Ti-Gr4 377, beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr 919, Ta 152, Ti-15Zr 776). The source day's median exceeds them for CP-Ti-Gr4, Ta, Ti-15Zr, Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-6Al-7Nb at every sampled angle and for every alloy at θ = 0, its upper whisker for every alloy; read at p99.9, the median exceeds them for every alloy. Inside the span of readings — knife-edges, not members: beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr (median, p99, θ = 45°); beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr (median, p99, every sampled angle). The gyroid⊥shank junction is a candidate the bound cannot see: at t_L = 1 its first layer absorbs 7.4 µm of radial mismatch, 2.75× the wood's strain over one rim period. The anode's bond force in the mature state is 746 N on a stiff bond and 103 N on a soft one (1654 N with a rigid sleeve at `103`'s stiff bond): the Zone 1 shank carries 7.9 MPa, and the tie reverses the force onto the barbs' easy flank — which 01_01 §4.3 A says nothing loads in service. The FLANGE DISC in state 2 on a rigid bark (673 N, Zone-3 fit) carries a worst nominal 97.1 MPa (disc_shank_root|b_pull_at_shank|rim_only_dished_seat): one-sided (a bearing without preload) it reaches SF 2 at K_f 1.51 on the printed route ⊥ 2.58 on the CNC route — the same number is its un-notched SF when a preload ≥ F carries both halves. On the air-dry bark reading the force is 66 N; the mature-state disc force is not bounded. The mass path stays below 0.33 MPa. Not computed: the field under traction (no case) — the static reading enters as a premise check only, not the thresholds (whether it should is an open 00_07 HW.23 leg) — the inclusion's field under the wood's multiaxial strain (the periodic cache holds uniaxial cases only), the junction (a junction model), t_L (`106` — conditional), the count of host-stem cycles above the threshold (the field sensor), any K_t, a barb row's ratchet force, the static means, ice, the collar and lug root.
